notes: 🤖 New: GlowBot, the Glow AI team as a Telegram bot. Give it a goal in a chat or a group; it plans the work, delegates it to its agents, checks the result and reports back
It also answers with web research, runs the AI crew, shares the day's AI news and writes a short tale with our own tiny AI
It shows its plan first and waits for your OK (a one-step job just runs), and you can steer or stop it at any time
The bot starts private: only its owner can use it until they open it to everyone
The GlowBot page lists every command, shows whether the bot is online, and shows its own self-test and which free models and search routes answer right now
Find it on Glow home, in the Glow apps menu, or with the 🤖 Telegram pill
